title: The holdout guard was filename-only, so a re-exported copy of a test image could train
symptom: A resized, re-encoded and renamed holdout image (the common Roboflow orig_jpg.rf.<hex>.jpg case) passed both the slug list and the stem filter.
root_cause: seen_hashes was never seeded with the holdout's own dHashes, so content-level identity was never checked.
correction_made: _load_holdout_dhashes() pre-seeds seen_hashes with all 1,977 holdout dHashes under a __HOLDOUT__ sentinel and counts skipped_holdout_hash; every subsequent run prints the counter.
